title: COMP Instance Page
summary: Official Derivative common Instance page reference for Geometry COMP hardware instancing, instance count sources, default instance OP data mapping, transform order, active masking, translate/rotate/scale/pivot attributes, and shader instance IDs.
guidance: Use this article when a Geometry COMP should render many hardware instances of the same SOP geometry.
Instance data can come from TOP RGBA channels, CHOP samples, SOP attributes, or DAT columns; the first Instance page maps source data to translate, rotate, scale, pivot, active, and count behavior.
Use Instance Count Mode manual when Num Instances should control count, and oplength when CHOP samples or DAT rows should determine the count.
Use instanceactive to skip instances whose active channel is zero; if no active source is assigned, all instances are rendered.
Pair this card with Instance 2 for rotate-to-vector, texture, color, and instance texture settings, and Instance 3 for GLSL custom attributes.
